settings.content: We've been taken back from the support we've received. This is our way to express gratitude for those who give so much. All orders (except wholesale) earn 10% cash back on every order in the form of points. These points can be used for $ OFF future orders. Thank you so much for your love and loyalty!

settings.question: How does the Cool Mom Sprinkles Reward Program work?
settings.answer: Our reward program is designed to make your shopping experience even sweeter! With every order you place (excluding wholesale orders), you automatically earn 10% cash back.

settings.question: Do I need to sign up for the Cool Mom Sprinkles Reward Program?
settings.answer: Yes, create an account, once signed in go to the rewards hub in the bottom left-hand corner, and opt-in for rewards.

settings.question: How do I earn cash back with the Cool Mom Sprinkles Reward Program?
settings.answer: Simply place an order on our website, and you'll automatically earn 10% cash back on the total amount spent before shipping. This applies to every order, except for wholesale orders. Must opt-in first!

settings.question: How do I redeem my cash back?
settings.answer: The Reward Points Hub in the bottom left-hand corner. Inside you can redeem points for a coupon of $ OFF. Apply coupon code at checkout and viola! It's a seamless process that allows you to save on your purchase effortlessly.

settings.question: Do the earned points or cash back expire?
settings.answer: No, your points and cash back never expire! We want you to enjoy the benefits at your own pace, without any pressure to use them within a specific timeframe.

settings.question: What should I do if I encounter any issues with the Cool Mom Sprinkles Reward Program?
settings.answer: If you have any questions or encounter issues related to our reward program, please contact us via Chat on the website in the bottom right-hand corner. We're here to assist you and ensure you have a delightful experience with Cool Mom Sprinkles!

settings.question: How can I check my points balance?
settings.answer: You can view your points balance in the Rewards Hub on the bottom left-hand side when logged in on our website. It will display the total points earned and available for use.

settings.question: Can I combine Cool Mom Sprinkles cash back with other discounts or promotions?
settings.answer: No, our website will only allow one discount code to be used per order. Discount codes are how you redeem cash back from points.

settings.question: Are wholesale orders eligible for the 10% cash back?
settings.answer: No, the 10% cash back is not applicable to wholesale orders. As wholesale customers used to earn points, we've updated wholesale discounts from 40% to 50%, to fill the gap of no points.

settings.question: Is the Cool Mom Sprinkles Reward Program available internationally?
settings.answer: Yes, our reward program is available to all customers, both domestic and international. Everyone can enjoy the perks of our program, regardless of their location.
